verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is a web-based state filing service, and a web service could plausibly offer a cookie or analytics opt-out, so the privacy axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, cookies, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The documents cover only business formation, annual-report e-filing, payments and browser support, and the robots.txt probe concerns crawler access, not user tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
